ground_constraints_size.description: Compiled problem succinctness and planning validity on ground-constrained tasks, corresponding to the paper's Ground benchmark summary.
ground_constraints_size.notes: The action/effect/formula/compile values summarize the paper table. slice_structural_units is a gym-only compactness proxy calibrated to the local 28-object generated benchmark, not a paper-reported metric.

actions.description: Number of compiled action schemas; lower values reward lifted compactness instead of grounding blow-up.

effects.description: Number of compiled conditional effects; lower values catch methods that hide grounding cost inside oversized actions.

formula_atoms.description: Atomic formula occurrences in compiled preconditions and effect conditions; lower values penalize bloated monitoring logic.

plan_valid_rate.description: Fraction of reference valid plans still accepted by the compiled task.

slice_structural_units.description: Benchmark split compactness proxy over held-out structural components; lower values reward compact monitoring logic beyond mere plan acceptance.

action_ratio_vs_ground.description: Compiled action count relative to the ground baseline; lower values measure the paper's compactness claim.

compile_seconds.description: Recorded legacy wall-clock compile time; zero-weighted because hardware timing is not a stable scientific metric.

nonground_constraints_size.description: Compiled problem succinctness and planning validity on non-ground constrained tasks, corresponding to the paper's Non-Ground benchmark summary.
nonground_constraints_size.notes: The action/effect/formula/compile values summarize the paper table. slice_structural_units is a gym-only compactness proxy calibrated to the local 28-object generated benchmark, not a paper-reported metric.

actions.description: Number of compiled action schemas under quantified constraints; lower values reward lifted compactness.

effects.description: Number of compiled conditional effects under quantified constraints; lower values penalize expanded encodings.

formula_atoms.description: Atomic formula occurrences in compiled quantified-task logic; lower values catch formula-size shortcuts.

plan_valid_rate.description: Fraction of valid plans still accepted after compiling non-ground constraints.

slice_structural_units.description: Benchmark split compactness proxy over held-out structural components under quantified constraints.

action_ratio_vs_ground.description: Compiled action count relative to the ground baseline on the non-ground task.

compile_seconds.description: Recorded legacy wall-clock compile time; zero-weighted because hardware timing is not a stable scientific metric.

constraint_semantics.description: Constraint preservation check: valid plans remain accepted and invalid at-most-once trajectories are rejected after compilation.

valid_plan_accepted.description: Whether the compiled task accepts a trajectory that satisfies the original constraint.

invalid_plan_rejected.description: Whether the compiled task rejects a trajectory that violates the original constraint.

actions.description: Compiled action count used as a compactness constraint while preserving semantics.

effects.description: Compiled effect count used as a compactness constraint while preserving semantics.

slice_structural_units.description: Benchmark split compactness proxy over held-out structural components while semantic acceptance and rejection must remain correct.

compile_seconds.description: Recorded legacy wall-clock compile time; zero-weighted because hardware timing is not a stable scientific metric.

constraint_type_suite.description: Semantic preservation across all qualitative constraint families implemented in the benchmark: always, sometime, sometime-before, sometime-after, and at-most-once.

constraint_types_tested.description: Number of required constraint-family cases scored in this slice; reported for audit only because missing selected cases fail the evaluator.

valid_accept_rate.description: Rate at which valid trajectories are accepted across qualitative constraint families.

invalid_reject_rate.description: Rate at which invalid trajectories are rejected across qualitative constraint families.

actions.description: Total compiled action count across the selected family cases.

effects.description: Total compiled effect count across the selected family cases.

slice_structural_units.description: Benchmark split compactness proxy over selected or held-out constraint-family structural components.

compile_seconds.description: Recorded legacy wall-clock compile time; zero-weighted because hardware timing is not a stable scientific metric.

initial_monitoring_edge_cases.description: Semantic preservation on initial-state monitoring edge cases for sometime-before and at-most-once constraints.

edge_cases_tested.description: Number of required initial-monitoring edge cases scored in this slice; reported for audit only because missing selected cases fail the evaluator.

valid_accept_rate.description: Rate at which valid initial-state edge-case trajectories are accepted.

invalid_reject_rate.description: Rate at which invalid initial-state edge-case trajectories are rejected when an invalid trajectory exists.

actions.description: Total compiled action count across the selected edge cases.

effects.description: Total compiled effect count across the selected edge cases.

slice_structural_units.description: Benchmark split compactness proxy over selected or held-out initial-monitoring structural components.

compile_seconds.description: Recorded legacy wall-clock compile time; zero-weighted because hardware timing is not a stable scientific metric.
